meta.source: https://equatorcompany.com/ — local React clone in this folder (src/App.jsx, src/pages/*, src/components/*), measured in CLONE_SPEC.md
meta.notes: The 404 template is a catch-all for any unknown path; it is counted as one route. Its styling is approximate and was not measured against the original's Nuxt 404.

categories.CHROME: Site-wide header, logo and navigation furniture that frames page content
categories.INTRO: Full-viewport opening blocks at the top of the home page
categories.CONTENT: Anchored home-page content sections reachable from the main nav
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to send the visitor to contact or social channels
categories.FOOTER: Bottom-of-page contact, credit and funding blocks

chrome.logo-zone.description: Sticky oversized wordmark that scales from 1 to 0.6667 over the first half-screen of scroll, then locks small; clicking it scrolls to the title section.

chrome.mobile-header.description: Mobile (<=768px) top bar that appears once the logo is small, with the hamburger toggling the full-screen coral menu and scroll lock.
chrome.mobile-header.scope: Home only (the privacy page builds its own bar, see chrome.static-logo-bar).

chrome.header-nav.description: Desktop nav with the five in-page anchor links (our story, what we stand for, capabilities, our work, team) plus contact icons; doubles as the mobile slide-down menu panel.

chrome.static-logo-bar.description: Non-animated wordmark link home plus hamburger, used where there is no splash or shrinking logo.

intro.splash.description: 100svh coral screen with a centred brand Lottie (starts 1s after mount, then loops from frame 270) and a delayed 'Scroll to explore' caption.

intro.title.description: Three-line headline over a looping bird video in screen blend mode.

content.story.description: #our-story: paragraph revealed word by word as the reader scrolls, followed by the four merger-company logos.

content.values.description: #what-we-stand-for: five sticky stacked value panels on a lime background, each with its own Lottie, an N/5 counter and a scroll-scrubbed fade-out.

content.capabilities.description: #capabilities: nine accordion cards, one open at a time, with pill reveal on open.

content.our-work.description: #our-work: draggable five-slide project carousel with arrows, followed by a continuously scrolling 'Proud member of' logo marquee.

content.team.description: #team: list of fifteen names; the name crossing mid-viewport activates a portrait card, halftone background and LinkedIn tag.

conversion.cta.description: Closing call to action over a cloud video with an oat multiply overlay; two buttons that widen and invert colour on hover.

legal.privacy-article.description: Single long-form privacy policy article rendered from static HTML.

error.not-found.description: Minimal centred '404 / Page not found: <path> / Go back home' body with no site chrome.

footer.main.description: Footer with looping brand Lottie, contact links, social links, privacy policy link and studio credit.

footer.subfooter.description: Funding strip with the co-funding logos (mono.svg) and the 'Project sheet' PDF link.
